items.q: That's when I met you, November 8, 1941... Singer; that was Harold Singer; wasn't it?

ctx.x: That's when I met you, November 8, 1941. My wife and I were on our honeymoon, we were working in Boulder, we met you in front of the hotel, you were getting in your flexible, (inaudible). You, Melvin Moore and Cornbread--tenor sax--
Singer; that was Harold Singer; wasn't it?

items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: as Hal Singer said, he loved me, he says I got him where he could be seen.
